messages:
rachel: Kicking off staged rollout r-2026.03.25-rc1 -> 3 waves (5% each). deploy id=20260325-rc1. Will request stop/go at each wave.
deploy-bot: Wave1 (5%) live in eu-west. variant=r-2026.03.25-rc1. logs: https://redwood.internal/deploy/20260325-rc1
sre-lee: Observability: p50 ok, p99 embeddings in eu-west jumped +420ms after wave1; 502s +2.1%. dashboard: https://dash/reports/6287654321
tom: Noticed increased evictions on the KV store and a couple of worker restarts. guessing memory pressure.
rachel: Pause wave2. let's triage quickly before we expand. deploy-bot will wait for manual go.
ops-bot: safety-latch applied by rachel: max_wave_increment=0, pause_on_p99>400ms, notify=#eng-releases.
sre-lee: Recommend isolating embedding traffic back to previous variant in eu-west while keeping other routes on rc1. That could avoid full rollback.
tom: +1 to isolate embed path to v2026-03-22 for eu-west.
rachel: Agreed. Doing route-split and then purge KV caches.
deploy-bot: Routing change applied: embeddings->v2026-03-22, other services->r-2026.03.25-rc1. KV purge job queued.
sre-lee: After split and purge: p99 back to baseline, 502s dropped. Good signal.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-411 opened (owner: tom). Summary: memory regression in embed pipeline on rc1; mitigation: regional embed pin, KV purge, add preflight mem checks.
rachel: Updating release notes: "eu-west: embeddings pinned to v2026-03-22 due to memory pressure observed on r-2026.03.25-rc1; other services remain on rc1."
Tom: Follow-ups: add mem-delta preflight to rollout CI, add canary specifically exercising embed pipeline, and schedule a rollback drill.
rachel: Thanks everyone. Keeping stop/go open for 12h. Will post postmortem stub in #postmortems once we have timeline.
